title: Fix DM continuation message collapsing into the avatar column
summary: The Product Development Lead reports a local fix: explicitly place DM message content in grid column 2 and add a screenshot guard that checks lead/continuation alignment. Their thread reply reports phone, both iPad widths, and desktop coverage, eight DM tests, five tools tests, and a guard that fails when the regression is restored. No matching active task was found; the related older task task_01a0e22c-c824-754f-b0e8-a6a62c619001 is done and covers earlier pending-DM collapse, not this recurrence.
